keyword: # Edit this file in Excel or Notepad. One rule per line: keyword
# - The keyword is looked for in the transaction Particulars (case does not matter).
# - It matches WHOLE words: "RANE" matches "RANE MADRAS LTD" but not "SRANE" or "RANEX".
#   Put * at the end to match the start of a word: "SAMKRG*" also matches "SAMKRGPISTONS".
# - Rules are checked top to bottom; the FIRST match wins. Put specific names first.
# - Special groups the report treats separately:
#     Owner transfer   - money to/from the owner (not counted as a supplier payment or collection)
#     Cash withdrawal  - self cheques / ATM cash
#   Any other group name you type becomes its own payee group in the report.
# --- Loans / drawdown (kept above the owner rules: drawdown lines also carry the owner's name) ---
# --- Owner: names and the owner's own account number(s) ---
